models_evaluated: Epic case duration estimation tool (user-adjusted and vendor-recommended configurations)

links.outcome: ML case duration accuracy vs existing scheduling, historical averages, and Epic tool
links.effect: Baseline MAE 35.3 min (bias -31 min); standardized workflow plus vendor-recommended Epic MAE 20.1 min; ORchestra MAE 19.8 min, bias +1.2 min. Standardization alone approached ML-level accuracy for many procedures.
links.quote: Notably, workflow standardization alone approached ML-level accuracy for many procedures, highlighting human-factor variability as a dominant source of error.

links.outcome: Effect of inconsistent software configuration and duration definitions on prediction error
links.effect: User-adjusted settings and inconsistent prep/wrap inclusion gave MAE 35.3 min, f30min 0.52, f10% 0.09; vendor-recommended Epic settings with standardized definitions gave MAE 20.1 min, f30min 0.81, f10% 0.37.
links.quote: Standardizing workflow elements-specifically, consistent inclusion of prep/wrap time and use of vendor-recommended Epic settings-substantially improved performance (MAE = 20.1 min, f<sub>30min</sub> = 0.81, and f<sub>10%</sub> = 0.37).

unlisted_practices: Standardizing operational definitions (e.g., inclusion of prep/wrap time) across users before deploying predictive scheduling tools

models_evaluated: Epic CDE tool (user-adjusted and vendor-recommended configurations)

links.outcome: Surgical duration prediction accuracy compared with standardized existing scheduling practices
links.effect: Standardized workflow MAE = 20.1 min versus ORchestra MAE = 19.8 min; standardization approached ML-level accuracy for many procedures, while ORchestra decreased overscheduling outliers.
links.quote: Notably, workflow standardization alone approached ML-level accuracy for many procedures, highlighting human-factor variability as a dominant source of error.

unlisted_practices: Standardize surgical case-duration definitions to consistently include prep/wrap time and use vendor-recommended scheduling-software settings.

links.outcome: Prediction error (MAE) vs baseline and software
links.effect: The ML model had an MAE of 19.8 min, compared to 35.3 min for baseline practices and 20.1 min for standardized Epic settings.
links.quote: The ORchestra ML model further reduced error (MAE = 19.8 min), eliminated systematic bias (+1.2 min), and decreased overscheduling outliers, with the largest gains observed in high-variability services.

unlisted_practices: Standardizing software configuration and workflow definitions alongside AI deployment
